-- intro: {{Infobox/Magic |image= En Heavy Mushroom.png  |title= Fungus Magic |kanji= 菌魔法 |romaji= Kin Mahō |english= Fungus Magic (VIZ, Funimation)  |user= #En Ringard }} {{Nihongo|Fungus Magic|菌魔法|Kin Mahō}} is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and manipulate fungi.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to generate and manipulate fungi at will. In order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires.
    The user can spread the spores and attach them to others for activation later.{{Clr}}
